test_title: PYST 27: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Peak.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options the correct option to fill in the blank is** Peak. **
 
• **Peak: **The greatest, strongest, or best aspect, quality, or level of proficiency.
 
 
• **Example:*** Pollution is at its peak in Delhi. *
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct option is** Peak. **

**​**The correct sentence is: **Your brain is at its peak in the morning.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pick** refers to taking some things and leaving others.
 
• **Pique** refers to a feeling of anger, especially caused by someone damaging your feeling of being proud of yourself.
 
• **Peek** refers to gaze, especially quickly or when attempting to hide from view.
